owner_overlay_requirements.title: Privacy-safe high-intent website inbound attribution
required_behavior: Capture captured_at, origin_channel, path-only landing_path, referrer classification, allowlisted UTM, optional lawfully supplied Metrika identifiers and prior_path.
Map missing analytics dimensions to UNKNOWN.
Keep PII, request text and raw Metrika visit/client IDs in a separate private record.
Expose only Metrika presence flags to analytics, Bitrix projection and evidence.
Use opaque form-to-Bitrix correlation without PII.
Apply deterministic source hierarchy UTM > classified external referrer > direct website > UNKNOWN and retain reconciliation lineage.
Never treat Metrika identifiers as source proof.
Remain synthetic fixture/shadow-only with zero external effects.

owner_overlay_requirements.title: Privacy-safe owner intent capture without authority activation
required_behavior: Capture strategic commercial intent separately from exactly one inactive first-cell proposal.
Treat 5/1/1 only as shadow review-queue limits, never production capacity evidence.
Record Bank API as a preferred future payment source with format still pending.
Represent Dima only by an opaque human actor ref with no self-review, payment, policy, arbitration, verifier or release authority.
Keep raw owner chat, PII and credentials out of the artifact and leave every authority/effect flag false.

owner_overlay_requirements.title: Bitrix contract-signed application status without payment promotion
required_behavior: Accept only the sealed delivery-local fixture stage mapping while the real stage code remains UNKNOWN and blocked.
Create one non-KPI CRM projection claim with CONTRACT_SIGNED_AWAITING_PAYMENT and zero transport/effect.
Never create PaymentProof, paid OrderRecord or a cleared-payment outcome from CRM.
Apply deterministic source hierarchy FULFILLED > PAID > PAYMENT_RECONCILED > CONTRACT_SIGNED_AWAITING_PAYMENT.
Use opaque non-PII remote IDs, exact replay receipts, chronology checks and verified backup/restore.
